parts.label: (a)
parts.text: The random variables $W$ and $X$ have the independent distributions $\text{Po}(1.2)$ and $\text{Po}(2.3)$ respectively.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: The random variable $S$ is the sum of 100 independent values of $W$ and 200 independent values of $X$.
parts.text: Use a suitable approximation to find $\text{P}(S > 600)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The random variable $Y$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(\lambda)$, where $\lambda > 0$.

It is given that $\frac{5}{2}\text{P}(Y = 3) + \text{P}(Y = 4) = \text{P}(Y = 5)$.

Find the value of $\lambda$.
